verdict.rationale: The SOS Business & Liens portal publishes an online rail to file a New Business, Amendment, Annual Renewal or Reinstatement, behind a standard Online Account. It supports multiple filings per account, payment through US Bank (including "Pay without Registering"), and a transaction history of completed filings, so the core form/file/pay transaction is completable online per the service's own pages. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of an end-to-end online formation filing, and detailed first-party documentation of the formation steps and processing outcome beyond portal menu labels.
